# Descriptions
@@ 1
Warms 1 cubic foot of stone per level up to 100ºF at a rate of 1 cu'bic foot
per round of concentration (without concentration, the material will remain at
its current temperature for the remainder of the duration).
@@ 2
As Warm Stone, except 6 cubic inches of metal per level can be warmed each
round.
@@ 3
As Warm Stone, except can affect any solid, inanimate, non-metal material.
@@ 4
As Warm Stone except temperature limit is 500ºF. In addition, caster must
concentrate for 1 round to raise the temperature 50ºF (up to the maximum).
Caster need only touch the target when the spell is cast.
@@ 5
As Heat Stone, except 6 cubic inches of metal per level can be heated.
@@ 6
As Heat Stone, except affects any solid, inanimate, nonmetal material.
@@ 7
As Warm Stone, except chills any solid, inanimate material down to 0ºF.
@@ 9
As Heat Stone, except temperature can be lowered to -200ºF at a rate of 100ºF
per round.
@@ 10
Any previous cracks or flaws in material up to 10'x10'x10' section will extend
to their limit.
@@ 11
As Heat Solid, except the only limit to the temperature is the melting point
of the solid (i.e., until the solid melts). Will affect 6 cubic inches of
metal or 1 cubic foot of any other material.
@@ 13
As Cracks Call, except material with cracks will crumble to dust.
@@ 14
Will break a piece of wood up to 1' in diameter.
@@ 15
Creates 3'x6'x1' doorway through stone.
@@ 16
As Stone Door, except doorway can be through metal.
@@ 17
As Bowbreak, except a piece of metal can be broken. Will affect metals up to
3'' in diameter.
@@ 18
Causes a lock to break. The lock can be broken in a locked or unlocked state
(regardless of its state at the time the spell is cast).
@@ 19
As Stone Door, except doorway can be in any inanimate, solid material and it
can be 3'x6' with a depth of 1' per level (for stone) or 3'' per level (for
all other materials).
@@ 20
By molding with his hands, caster may shape 1 cubic foot of stone as if it
were putty or clay. At the end of the spell’s duration, the stone will harden
to normal consistency.
@@ 25
As Mold Stone, except caster may mold metal.
@@ 30
As Mold Stone, except caster may mold any inanimate, solid material.
@@ 50
May transmute 1 oz. of solid material into another non-magical material (the
caster must have a sample of the material available). This spell takes 8 hours
of continous, uninterrupted concentration.
